primary.$description: An ARRAY so the CSS output carries a fallback: `'Lexend Deca', sans-serif`. It was the bare family until 2026-08-29, which meant a missing webfont fell through to the browser's default serif rather than to a sans — a wrong-looking page with nothing failing. The fallback is not drift from the design source: Figma has no concept of a fallback stack, and .figma/manifest.json -> identity.font already records `fallback: sans-serif` as measured. Loading the face is the consuming app's job, never the library's — see packages/react/README.md.

2xl.$description: Double XL - main titles. Unused in the mocks.

base.$description: Base text size - body, labels, buttons
